# Generated by pip-compile --generate-hashes.
# Run the following command from this directory to regenerate:
#
#   pip-compile --generate-hashes --output-file=requirements.lock.txt requirements.in
#
# This stub intentionally contains no hashed pins. ``Dockerfile.aws-enterprise``
# invokes ``pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.lock.txt``, so the
# image build will fail fast until an operator runs pip-compile in their own
# environment (CI or a developer workstation with network access). The lockfile
# is environment-specific (CPU arch, Python minor version) and must be produced
# per-platform; we ship the instruction rather than a placeholder lock that
# would silently bypass supply-chain controls.
